import re
import os

# Pattern to match all emoji characters
emoji_pattern = re.compile(
    ''[''
    ''\U0001F600-\U0001F64F''  # emoticons
    ''\U0001F300-\U0001F5FF''  # symbols & pictographs
    ''\U0001F680-\U0001F6FF''  # transport & map symbols
    ''\U0001F1E0-\U0001F1FF''  # flags
    ''\U00002702-\U000027B0''
    ''\U000024C2-\U0001F251''
    ''\U0001F900-\U0001F9FF''  # supplemental symbols
    ''\U0001FA00-\U0001FAFF''  # extended pictographs
    '']+'',
    flags=re.UNICODE
)

files = [
    ''content/svenska/svenska-2/skriftlig-framstallning/page.mdx'',
    ''content/svenska/svenska-2/retorik-muntlig-framstallning.mdx'',
    ''content/svenska/svenska-2/process/page.mdx'',
    ''content/svenska/svenska-2/genrer/page.mdx'',
    ''content/svenska/svenska-2/sprak-kallor/page.mdx'',
    ''content/svenska/svenska-2/bedomning/page.mdx'',
    ''content/svenska/svenska-2/litteratur-litteraturhistoria/page.mdx'',
    ''content/svenska/svenska-2/litteratur-litteraturhistoria/tolkning/page.mdx'',
    ''content/svenska/svenska-2/litteratur-litteraturhistoria/epoker/page.mdx'',
    ''content/svenska/svenska-2/litteratur-litteraturhistoria/arbetsformer/page.mdx'',
    ''content/svenska/svenska-2/sprak-sprakforhallanden/page.mdx'',
    ''content/svenska/svenska-2/sprak-sprakforhallanden/systemforstaelse/page.mdx'',
    ''content/svenska/svenska-2/sprak-sprakforhallanden/grammatik/page.mdx'',
    ''content/svenska/svenska-2/sprak-sprakforhallanden/stil-variation/page.mdx'',
    ''content/svenska/svenska-2/sprak-sprakforhallanden/nordiska-sprak/page.mdx'',
    ''content/svenska/svenska-2/sprak-sprakforhallanden/minoritetssprak/page.mdx'',
    ''content/svenska/svenska-2/sprak-sprakforhallanden/flersprakighet/page.mdx''
]

processed = 0
total_emojis_removed = 0

for filepath in files:
    try:
        with open(filepath, ''r'', encoding=''utf-8'') as f:
            content = f.read()
        
        # Count emojis before removal
        emojis_found = len(emoji_pattern.findall(content))
        
        # Remove emojis
        cleaned_content = emoji_pattern.sub('''', content)
        
        # Clean up any double spaces that might result from emoji removal
        cleaned_content = re.sub(r''  +'', '' '', cleaned_content)
        
        # Write back
        with open(filepath, ''w'', encoding=''utf-8'') as f:
            f.write(cleaned_content)
        
        processed += 1
        total_emojis_removed += emojis_found
        print(f''Processed: {filepath} - Removed {emojis_found} emojis'')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f''Error processing {filepath}: {str(e)}'')

print(f''\nTotal files processed: {processed}'')
print(f''Total emojis removed: {total_emojis_removed}'')
")
